ExcelProcessor.read_excel:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Loads the active worksheet from an Excel file, collects every row as a tuple into a list, and returns the list or None if loading or reading fails." read_excel]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> file_name </REF>: str "Path to the Excel file to read."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: list or None "A list of row tuples from the active worksheet, or None if an exception occurs."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize an empty list named data to store worksheet rows. RESULT data]
            [COMMAND Attempt to load the workbook from file_name using openpyxl.load_workbook. RESULT workbook]
            [COMMAND Get the active worksheet from the loaded workbook. RESULT sheet]
            [COMMAND For each row in the active worksheet with cell values only, append the row tuple to data. RESULT data]
            [COMMAND Close the workbook after all rows have been collected. RESULT workbook]
            [COMMAND Return data as the result. RESULT data]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If any exception occurs while loading the workbook, reading rows, or closing the workbook, the method falls back to a default result.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return None instead of the collected data. RESULT None]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ExcelProcessor.write_excel:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Creates a new Excel workbook, writes each row from the input data into the active sheet, saves the workbook to the given file name, and returns 1 on success or 0 if any exception occurs." write_excel]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> data </REF>: iterable of rows "Rows to append to the active worksheet."
        <REF> file_name </REF>: string "Destination path where the Excel workbook will be saved."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: integer "Returns 1 after successfully saving and closing the workbook, otherwise returns 0 if an exception is caught."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create a new Excel workbook and select its active worksheet. RESULT workbook, sheet]
            [COMMAND For each row in the input data, append the row to the active worksheet. RESULT sheet]
            [COMMAND Save the workbook to the provided file name. RESULT saved_workbook]
            [COMMAND Close the workbook after saving. RESULT closed_workbook]
            [COMMAND Return 1 to indicate success. RESULT 1]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: If any exception occurs during workbook creation, row appending, saving, or closing.]
        [LOG "The method catches the exception and returns 0 without re-raising it."]
        [THROW none "No exception is propagated."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ExcelProcessor.process_excel_data:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Process an Excel dataset by copying each row, appending a transformed value from column N, and writing the result to a new Excel file." process_excel_data]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> N </REF>: int "Column index used to inspect and append a value from each row."
        <REF> save_file_name </REF>: str "Source Excel file name used to read input data and derive the output file name."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: tuple|int "Returns 0 when input data is missing or the column index is out of range; otherwise returns the write result and the generated output file name."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read Excel data from save_file_name using self.read_excel and store the returned value in data. RESULT data]
            [COMMAND If data is None or N is greater than or equal to the length of data[0], return 0 immediately. RESULT 0]
            [COMMAND Initialize new_data as an empty list. RESULT new_data]
            [COMMAND For each row in data, create a shallow copy of the row as new_row. RESULT new_row]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over data, if str(row[N]).isdigit() is false, append the uppercase string form of row[N] to new_row. RESULT new_row]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over data, otherwise append the original row[N] value to new_row. RESULT new_row]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over data, append new_row to new_data. RESULT new_data]
            [COMMAND Derive new_file_name by taking the part of save_file_name before the first dot and appending _process.xlsx. RESULT new_file_name]
            [COMMAND Write new_data to new_file_name using self.write_excel and store the return value in success. RESULT success]
            [COMMAND Return success and new_file_name. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
